name: Blind 75 Core DSA Patterns
actionableStep: Master 7 fundamental patterns: Sliding Window, Two Pointers, Fast & Slow Pointers, Monotonic Stack, Binary Search, BFS/DFS, and 1D Dynamic Programming.

name: System Architecture & Scalability
actionableStep: Study real-world trade-offs: Caching (Redis), Load Balancing, Database Partitioning, Message Queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and CAP theorem.

name: Python & FastAPI Production Engineering
actionableStep: Build asynchronous REST endpoints with Pydantic validation, dependency injection, SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, and automated pytest suites.

name: Java & Enterprise Spring Boot
actionableStep: Understand Spring IoC, Dependency Injection, Spring Data JPA, Microservice boundaries, and JVM memory tuning.

name: Relational DBMS & Advanced SQL
actionableStep: Write complex analytical queries using window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), and analyze EXPLAIN query execution plans.

name: Generative AI, RAG & Vector Search
actionableStep: Implement production RAG with chunking strategies, vector search with Chroma/Qdrant, Gemini tool calling, and evaluation pipelines.

name: Docker Containerization & CI/CD
actionableStep: Create multi-stage Dockerfiles, Docker Compose multi-service stacks, and GitHub Actions workflows for automated test & build passes.

name: STAR Behavioral & Project Defense
actionableStep: Prepare 4 structured STAR stories: (1) Toughest technical bug resolved, (2) Architectural trade-off made, (3) Team conflict or deadline pressure, (4) Self-directed learning milestone.
